dedupe_keys.name: falkland islands road network and road culvert inventory with stanley harbour movement statistics falkland islands government saeri data portal

description: The Falklands Data Portal, a CKAN catalogue run by the South Atlantic Environmental Research Institute (SAERI), carries the Falkland Islands Government's road infrastructure layers. Contents: the islands' road network divided into road classes with names (updated June 2014), an inventory of culverts on the category B road network with culvert type, length, condition, water conditions and how often each floods (updated April 2015), and harbour movement statistics for 2005 to 2014; the portal also holds roads and off-road tracks mapped by others and a Stanley address layer. Producer: Falkland Islands Government Public Works and Environmental Planning, with SAERI's IMS-GIS data centre as publisher. Coverage: East and West Falkland and Stanley. Format and access: zipped GIS files with GeoJSON previews downloadable from each dataset page and through the CKAN API; SAERI also runs Lizmap web maps, including one of government property and services in Stanley. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Free. Caveats: the layers have not been updated since 2014 to 2015, and many other infrastructure entries on the same portal, notably St Helena's power grid, electricity lines, transformers and water lines, are listed as metadata only with closed licences. Simulation uses: a small island road and drainage network for accessibility, culvert flood-failure and road washout studies, and remote-community resilience planning. Related records: the Falkland Islands 2021 census tables (data-fig-falkland-islands-census-2021-tables-electrical-power-source-heating-fuel-housing-units) give household energy sources.
